data.revised_prompt:
High-quality polished 2x2 animation sprite sheet for a game attack FX only, no characters, no UI. Canvas divided visually into four equal quadrants by layout only, but with NO borders, NO labels, NO text. Solid pure #FF00FF magenta background fills entire image.

Subject in every quadrant: exactly two translucent jellyfish tentacles extending left-to-right, inspired by a cute soft jellyfish avatar color palette: lavender, cyan, and pink bioluminescent glow. Tentacles are smooth, elastic, glossy, semi-transparent soft candy / jellyfish tendrils with rounded ends, tiny glowing beads embedded along them, soft cyan rim highlights, subtle pink-lavender inner glow. They must look like jellyfish tentacles, NOT ropes, NOT snakes, NOT arms. Pure isolated FX only.

Composition: each frame centered in its quadrant with generous magenta padding. FX occupies a wide horizontal band in each cell, about 80% of the cell width and 35% of the cell height. Same scale and consistent style in all frames. Nothing crosses quadrant/cell edges. No avatars, faces, bodies, portraits, cards, scene background, target markers, objects, UI, text, labels, borders.

Quadrant animation timing:
Top-left Frame 1: two short curled translucent tentacles gathered on the left side of the cell, coiled/curling as if preparing to lash forward, tips still near left-middle, glossy cyan highlights and tiny glowing beads.
Top-right Frame 2: the same two tentacles stretch farther right in parallel wavy arcs, accelerating left-to-right, longer than frame 1, elastic motion with soft glow.
Bottom-left Frame 3: full extension to the right, two tentacles almost reaching 80% cell width, sharp slap impact at the right tips, bright pink-cyan spark streaks ONLY near the right tips, no explosion elsewhere.
Bottom-right Frame 4: recoil left-to-right form, tentacles partially pulled back with trailing glow wisps fading behind the tips, still oriented left-to-right, soft cyan/pink afterimage wisps.

Clean edges, sharp details, game-ready sprite sheet, vibrant bioluminescent translucent rendering on flat magenta chroma-key background.
